265:t_1:4.en:
$$セイミー$$
「...Huh, $$正太郎$$, $$ワッ太$$... Aren't you having seconds?」

265:t_1:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm just not that hungry today.」

265:t_1:7.en:
$$セイミー$$
「That's unusual. Have you got a fever?」

265:t_1:9.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「Both of you... are worried about our food reserves, aren't you?」

265:t_1:11.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「I, $$ルゥ・リルリ$$, am not a psychological counselor for nothing.」

265:t_1:12.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I guess there's no point trying to hide anything...」

265:t_1:13.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...We are worried. When I think about traveling like this without getting any more food...」

265:t_1:14.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So I thought we'd save even a little...」

265:t_1:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「Thanks, both of you. I think that's a fine sentiment.」

265:t_1:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「But! You can't fight on an empty stomach. Eat while you can!」

265:t_1:19.en:
$$メール$$
「It's all right. $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ and the support crew have worked all that out.」

265:t_1:21.en:
$n
「$$郁絵$$, could I have seconds? Today's mapo glass noodles are delicious.」

265:t_1:22.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Of course. There's plenty left, so eat all you like.」

265:t_1:23.en:
$n
「When it's your turn to cook, $$郁絵$$, I can't stop eating.」

265:t_1:24.en:
$$郁絵$$
「I'm so happy to hear you say that.」

265:t_1:25.en:
$$スズネ$$
「There you go again, $n... You're fawning over an older woman...」

265:t_1:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now, now, Miss $$スズネ$$! $n is in the prime of youth... Right now, food comes before romance!」

265:t_1:28.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm sorry. Your overbearing enthusiasm has killed my appetite...」

265:t_1:30.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm glad your fever went away so quickly, $n.」

265:t_1:31.en:
$n
「At a time like this, I can't stay in bed forever. ...Oh, is there still enough for seconds?」

265:t_1:32.en:
$$郁絵$$
「I'll give you an extra-large serving this time.」

265:t_1:35.en:
$n
「What's wrong, you two? If you don't hurry, there won't be any left for your seconds.」

265:t_1:36.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$n... Your $$血塗られた眼$$ came back, didn't they?」

265:t_1:39.en:
$n
「It did, to some extent. That's exactly why I'm eating.」

265:t_1:40.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's that supposed to mean!? Are you relieving stress!?」

265:t_1:41.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's... not good for you. $$谷川$$ and $$中原$$ said eating like that doubles your stress afterward.」

265:t_1:43.en:
$n
「...Once, there was a child who went through all kinds of incidents and closed off his heart...」

265:t_1:45.en:
$n
「He sat in a corner of his room with his knees drawn up from morning till night, doing nothing all day.」

265:t_1:46.en:
$n
「His father left him alone most of the time, but never let him skip meals... Do you know why?」

265:t_1:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's because he'd die if he didn't eat...」

265:t_1:48.en:
$n
「He could have stayed alive on an IV. But his father didn't want him to forget the strength to live.」

265:t_1:50.en:
$n
「It's the energy to live... You could also call it the will to live.」

265:t_1:51.en:
$n
「His father used eating to keep him aware of that, to make him feel that he was alive.」

265:t_1:53.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's about feeling that you're alive...」

265:t_1:54.en:
$n
「It's important to conserve food. But you should still eat properly, to keep anxiety from crushing you.」

265:t_1:55.en:
$n
「A meal someone has made for you means more than just getting nutrients.」

265:t_1:56.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「...$$郁絵$$, can I have seconds, too?」

265:t_1:58.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Of course. I'll give both of you extra-large servings, too.」

265:t_1:59.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$n... I'll eat so I don't give in to all the things we're facing.」

265:t_1:60.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll eat and keep doing my best to live... and get back to Earth.」

265:t_1:61.en:
$n
「That's the spirit. You're growing boys, so don't hold back for silly reasons.」

265:t_1:62.en:
$$セイミー$$
「So, $n... What happened to that child in the end?」

265:t_1:63.en:
$n
「...A lot happened after that, but he's doing well. He's lucky to have good friends and people around him.」

265:t_1:65.en:
$$ルゥ$$
(We don't need to worry about $n's mental health anymore.)

265:t_1:66.en:
$$ルゥ$$
(In that case, the problem is still...)

265:t_1:67.en:
$$赤木$$
「...It's an old cliche, but space really is vast.」

265:t_1:68.en:
$$青山$$
「How can you say something so carefree in this situation?」

265:t_1:69.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're a strange one, too. You're just a salaryman, but you've got some damn guts.」

265:t_1:70.en:
$$赤木$$
「Of course. As a kid, I dreamed of being an astronaut or a space explorer, too.」

265:t_1:71.en:
$$赤木$$
「I think I understand how bad things are. But deep down, I can't help feeling excited.」

265:t_1:72.en:
$$青山$$
「...Actually, between us... I feel the same.」

265:t_1:73.en:
$$赤木$$
「You feel that way too, $$青山$$?」

265:t_1:74.en:
$$青山$$
「Yeah... Embarrassingly enough, it's for the same reason as you, $$赤木$$.」

265:t_1:75.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't be embarrassed! Men have a boy's heart, no matter how old they get.」

265:t_1:76.en:
$$赤木$$
「Coming to the middle of the galaxy woke up the back-alley space kids inside us.」

265:t_1:77.en:
$$青山$$
「Maybe so. I'm surprised I still have that childish side in me.」

265:t_1:78.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Whatever you say, you're one of $$赤木$$'s buddies after all, $$青山$$.」

265:t_1:79.en:
$$青山$$
「I can accept that as my usual short straw, but you'd better not let $$いぶき$$ hear you say it.」

265:t_1:80.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're right. Even I don't want to make $$いぶき$$ angry.」

265:t_1:82.en:
$$赤木$$
「Here comes another adult who hasn't forgotten his boyhood heart.」
